result:
Round 46 passes. I re-ran everything myself and tested the built app the way a user would. I found no bugs. `realVerified` is true, and the source tree was the same at the start and end of my check.

- **R46-1 (file ownership): pass.** HEAD is c822d7f. All 14 changed files are in the ownership table, each "only" file changes just the lines the task names, and every frozen and protected path is byte-identical.
- **R46-2 (red/green and mutants): pass.** I ran A's tests on a copy of the c822d7f source. Main had 9 failures and 13 passes; renderer had 6 failures and 117 passes. Both match A's report. All five mutants (M1–M5), plus an extra one I added (M1b), were caught by named tests.
- **R46-3 (gate): pass.** The full verify command exited 0: renderer 326/326, main 120/120, end-to-end tests 7/7. Biome reports 0 errors and 8 warnings. The end-to-end tests also passed 7/7 with retries turned off.
- **R46-4 (unset number not written): pass.** I added a custom Number field "Take" in the built app and saved only a title on a fresh WAV. The Take tag (ID `TAKE`) is absent in the raw INFO chunk, in ffprobe and in music-metadata. The same steps on a c822d7f build wrote `TAKE='0'`, so this round fixed the bug.
- **R46-5 (typed 0 is written): pass.** Typing `0` and saving writes a 1-byte `'0'` that all three readers see. After selecting another file and coming back, the field shows `0` and the row shows Tagged.
- **R46-6 (clearing a number): pass.**
  - **Single file:** clearing Take removes it. Category and Comment stay.
  - **Batch:** I typed `1` then Backspace and saved, and got "Tags saved to 2 files". Both files lost Take and kept their own Category.
  - Files I didn't select are byte-identical, and the app logged no page errors.
- **R46-7 (standard Year): recorded, as the task asked (not a FAIL).** Year `2024` is written and clearing removes it. Year `0` writes nothing and shows empty afterwards. This is the known library limit (Deviation 1).
- **R46-8 (docs): pass.** The contract doc and both primitives files have the D-50 changes.

**Notes for root and B (they don't change the verdict):**
- A changed three lines in `metadata.ts` with `sed -i`, which the task forbids (Edit/Write only). A reported this itself and the result is exactly what the task specifies. Root decides on this.
- A passes the number to the Take input instead of using `String(v)` as the task says, to fix a bug the code reviewer found. In the real app, typing `1.05` keeps the text `1.05` and saves it. I accept this deviation; B should record it.
- Test (r3) was on the task's list of tests that should fail on c822d7f, but it passes there. A's explanation is correct: the old `0` came from the main-process read, and test (n2) covers that and does fail on c822d7f.
